BiblicalUsage: Jeremiah says the word of the LORD was made a derision to him daily, and the psalmist says God made Israel a scorn and a derision to the nations round about. The word is what mockers make of God's people and his prophet — a laughing-stock.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe being made a laughing-stock for God's word is not a sign he has left you; it is the lot of his prophets, and he sees every jeer.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
